pages.text: A tool is a combination of parts. Changing one part can change its performance or traits without requiring you to abandon the entire tool.$(br2)Before assembling an expensive tool, look at what each part contributes. Decide what the tool is for: everyday mining, clearing an area, gathering a particular resource or fighting. Build around that job.
The workshop quests divide tools into their parts and associated casts so you can prepare each step separately.
